chunks: And Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام:
Regarding a woman who took the virginity of a bondwoman with her hand, he said: "She must pay the dowry, and the hadd punishment is to be carried out upon her."

key_terms.الْمَهْرُ: the financial compensation owed here for the injury

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman manually takes the virginity of a bondwoman?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who violated a bondwoman in a way that caused the loss of her virginity. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام rules that financial compensation is due in the form of mahr, and that a prescribed legal punishment is also imposed.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5001 - Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who reported from Abu Abdullah (as)

regarding a woman who took the virginity of a bondwoman with her hand.
Imam (as) said: "She must pay the dowry and is to be subjected to the legal punishment (Hadd)."
